summary: [[character:bill]] receives [[character:milo]]'s report that [[location:vulcan]] and [[location:romulus]] in [[location:omicron2-eridani]] can support habitation. He forwards it toward [[location:earth]] while fearing that no one may remain there, continues broadcasting SCUT plans to nearby systems, and reflects on feeling responsible for [[species:human|humanity]]. Bill is also pursuing realistic artificial bodies. In [[technology:vr]], [[character:garfield]] reports mapping the [[location:kuiper-belt]] for large ice chunks and marking two promising ones for eventual transport to Ragnarök.

updates.current_state: At [[location:epsilon-eridani]], forwarding [[character:milo]]'s report of habitable planets toward [[location:earth]] while pursuing artificial bodies and feeling responsible for [[species:human|humanity]].
Mapping the [[location:kuiper-belt]] for large ice chunks to transport to Ragnarök; he has marked two promising chunks with beacons.

updates.description: Artificial muscle-fiber analogues are under development for constructing realistic robots or androids. [[character:bill]] judges that a workable android needs muscles that resemble natural muscle in operation and appearance, rather than gears, pistons, or cables.
